description: Fen Pall final close-out (3 clean needed, 5 standing): pure restatements of the three proven compositions (wave6 three-quarter flight, wave6 fog-hang, wave8 frontal). Banned this wave: water contact (grounds it), light-source-behind (candle), rear views, reeds. Alone-positives added against the wave8 background-companion pressure. Fresh seeds.

subjects.prompt: a Fen Pall utterly alone in the empty fen, laboring through mist high over black bog water at a three-quarter angle, two uneven drooping wings of cracked translucent amber tallow sheets pierced by yellow-brown fen-bone struts, the left wing larger and hanging lower, a ragged matted dark peat-flesh body trailing loose strands into the air, a smooth pale featureless head-bulb with one small dark hollow and a single long amber tallow drip falling away beneath it, colours peat black-brown, tallow gold, bone ash, a single creature, pale misty background

a Fen Pall hanging heavy in cold fog mid-beat, nothing else living in the gloom around it, its two uneven wings of cracked amber tallow sheets sagging between yellow-brown fen-bone struts with torn dripping edges, the matted dark peat-flesh body a ragged mass beneath the wings trailing loose strands, a smooth blank pale head-bulb with one dark hollow and a single amber drip hanging from it, colours peat black-brown, tallow gold, bone ash, a single creature, dark misty background
